topFixes.title: Missing H1
topFixes.whyThisRanks: No joined GSC visibility is available for these affected URLs; Search Console evidence is skipped. This ranks as a fix. Severity is 100; 1 URL is affected; estimated effort is low.
topFixes.howToFix: Add one clear H1 near the top of the main content. Make it describe the specific page, not just a generic section label.
topFixes.howToVerify: Re-run the crawl and confirm an H1 describes the page’s main visible topic.

verification.expected: Re-run the crawl and confirm an H1 describes the page’s main visible topic.

reviewObservations.whyThisRanks: No joined GSC visibility is available for these affected URLs; Search Console evidence is skipped. This is a review observation. Confirm it before scheduling implementation work.
reviewObservations.howToFix: Remove the noindex directive if the page should rank. Leave it in place only for intentionally private or low-value pages.
reviewObservations.howToVerify: Re-run the crawl or URL Inspection and confirm no effective meta robots or X-Robots-Tag noindex remains, including the equivalent none directive.

verification.expected: Re-run the crawl or URL Inspection and confirm no effective meta robots or X-Robots-Tag noindex remains, including the equivalent none directive.

reviewObservations.title: Title may truncate on some devices
reviewObservations.whyThisRanks: No joined GSC visibility is available for these affected URLs; Search Console evidence is skipped. This is a review observation. Confirm it before scheduling implementation work.
reviewObservations.howToFix: Review the title rather than shortening it blindly. Put the clearest page-specific wording first and remove filler only when meaning is preserved.
reviewObservations.howToVerify: Re-run the audit and review estimatedPixels, referencePixels, confidence, and profile. Confirm the important wording appears early.

verification.expected: Re-run the audit and review estimatedPixels, referencePixels, confidence, and profile. Confirm the important wording appears early.

reviewObservations.title: Multiple H1 headings
reviewObservations.whyThisRanks: No joined GSC visibility is available for these affected URLs; Search Console evidence is skipped. This is a review observation. Confirm it before scheduling implementation work.
reviewObservations.howToFix: Review the headings before changing anything. If one heading describes the whole page, keep it as the H1 and move the others to H2 or below so the outline stays consistent.
reviewObservations.howToVerify: Re-run the crawl and confirm h1Count matches the intended heading structure.

verification.expected: Re-run the crawl and confirm h1Count matches the intended heading structure.

reviewObservations.title: Canonicalized page
reviewObservations.whyThisRanks: No joined GSC visibility is available for these affected URLs; Search Console evidence is skipped. This is a review observation. Confirm it before scheduling implementation work.
reviewObservations.howToFix: If this URL should rank, make the canonical self-referencing. If another URL is preferred, make internal links and sitemap entries point to that preferred URL.
reviewObservations.howToVerify: Re-run the crawl and confirm the canonical target matches the intended indexable URL.

verification.expected: Re-run the crawl and confirm the canonical target matches the intended indexable URL.

reviewObservations.title: No structured data detected
reviewObservations.whyThisRanks: No joined GSC visibility is available for these affected URLs; Search Console evidence is skipped. This is a review observation. Confirm it before scheduling implementation work.
reviewObservations.howToFix: Add structured data only where a schema type genuinely describes the page, for example an article page describing its article. Validate the markup after adding it, and leave pages without a fitting schema type unmarked.
reviewObservations.howToVerify: Re-run the crawl and confirm structuredDataFormats lists the added format, then validate the page with a structured data tester.

verification.expected: Re-run the crawl and confirm structuredDataFormats lists the added format, then validate the page with a structured data tester.
